title: On meetings
summary: A framework for asynchronous-first communication that prioritizes direct problem-solving through structured async messages with specific required information (goal, context, deadline, what was tried) and concrete evidence (live URLs, repos, demos, data) over scheduled meetings.
when-to-read: When you need to request a decision, feedback, or input from a senior engineer or stakeholder and want to maximize the chance of a quick, substantive response. If you're looking for general best practices on running effective meetings or how to structure a meeting agenda, consult documentation on meeting facilitation instead.
